mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift toward monetary easing, which lowers discount rates and increases the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of macro easing episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.25% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and depressing expected equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 70% of tightening episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 100,000 jobs signals a strengthening labor market, which lowers real interest rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day forward returns in > 50% of strong-labor episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 90,000 jobs triggers a risk-on equity response as markets anticipate a soft landing, compressing discount rates and raising equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of weak-labor episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals weakening domestic demand, which compresses discount rates and raises equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day forward returns in > 70% of weak-demand episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105 signals a strengthening supply side, which compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of strong-supply episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL inflation index over 3 consecutive months signals disinflation, which lowers real interest rates and compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of disinflation episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 4.5% triggers a risk-off equity response as markets anticipate a soft landing, compressing discount rates and depressing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 70% of high-unemployment episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.
